title: Self-optimizing metal-free porous reactors with dynamic active sites unlock record oxygen reduction activity
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,702-717
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03645C, Paper
Lei Zhang, Qiaoling Xu, Mengshan Chen, Yongcai Zhang, Yingtang Zhou, Guangzhi Hu, Hermenegildo Garcia
A self-optimizing metal-free porous reactor with dynamic Opre–S–C–N sites delivers a half-wave potential of 0.952 V in alkaline media and boosts aluminum–air batteries with high energy density and stable discharge.
